newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenian shares stage moderate technical rebound.
newsitem.headline: Slovenian shares stage moderate technical rebound.

text.p: Slovenian shares ended a touch firmer on Wednesday, rebounding after two days of losses.
But traders said turnover remained extremely sluggish and see no pick-up in activity over the short term.
* The SBI index rose 0.22 percent or 2.88 points to 1,318.92.
* Turnover fell to 59.2 million tolars from 91.3 million tolars.

* Shopping centre operator BTC was among the top gainers, jumping 5.46 percent to 14,790 tolars on volume of 418 shares. BTC rose on expectation it would soon finalise its global depository receipts (GDRs) issue. -- Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439
